company.name: Britannia Crown Removals & Storage Ltd
company.description: Family-owned domestic and commercial removals and self-storage firm trading since 1998, operating across Yorkshire, the North West, the Midlands and the London corridor. Services: full and part-load house moves, office and laboratory relocations, professional packing and export wrapping, fragile/antique and piano handling, dismantle and reassemble, container and crate storage, and white-glove deliveries. British Association of Removers (BAR) member; holds a standard national operator (O) licence issued by the Traffic Commissioner for the North East of England.

metadata.generatedNote: Operating week Mon 2026-06-22 to Sun 2026-06-28 for Britannia Crown Removals & Storage. The diary covers a full house move with piano handling (Leeds to Harrogate), a phased out-of-hours office relocation (London EC1 to Bristol over two nights), a -80C laboratory cold-chain move for the University of Leeds, part-loads and stair-carry domestic moves, a downsizing move with vault storage, an end-of-tenancy WEEE clearance, a care-home delivery and install, and storage-vault trunking between the Manchester and Leeds depots. Scheduling follows GB drivers' hours (retained Regulation (EC) 561/2006 with GB domestic rules), the GB tachograph regime, DVSA MOT and roadworthiness inspection cycles, DVLA licence categories, ADR carriage of dangerous goods, BAR/RHA standard conditions of carriage, and the firm's standard national O-licence.

notes.author: Aisha Rahman (surveyor)
notes.body: Survey volume 1,980 cu ft confirmed against 56 cu m. Customer keen to protect the upright piano and a 1920s grandfather clock - both flagged as high-value fragile. Recommend 4-man crew and stair runners at the Harrogate end.

notes.author: Gary Hollings (crew lead)
notes.body: Job ran smoothly. Minor scuff to hall skirting at destination while turning the piano - photographed and logged. Customer happy overall and signed off. Offered to send a touch-up on the next visit.

notes.author: Priya Nair (client)
notes.body: Please prioritise the partners' offices on floors 5 and 6 on night one. IT cabinets must NOT be touched until our MSP confirms decommission on night two.

notes.author: Dr Helen Marsden (client)
notes.body: Samples are the priority - several represent years of work. Cool boxes will be pre-chilled and dry ice topped up before you arrive. I will escort the load from the lab to your cold store and back.

notes.author: Workshop foreman
notes.body: Clutch slipping badly under load on the R450; OBD shows P0810. Booked off-road for clutch replacement and a full DVSA roadworthiness prep ahead of the July MOT. Cover trunking with VEH-005 where possible.

notes.author: Tom Beresford (lead porter)
notes.body: Third-floor flat with no lift and a 30-minute loading bay limit. Plan to shuttle with the T6 to the lorry parked on Chester Road. Budget extra man-hours for the stair carry - it is a long one.

notes.author: Aisha Rahman (surveyor)
notes.body: Roughly six vaults to storage, the rest onward to Huddersfield. Gravel drive at the new place - take track mats, it gets soft in the wet. Antique writing desk and two oil paintings need export wrap.

notes.author: Sales office
notes.body: Repeat customer (third move with us). Booked six vaults for three months alongside the move. Baby grand piano bundled in as WO-2026-0545 - declared value GBP 18,000, four-man specialist team required.

notes.author: Sandra Whitfield (delivery lead)
notes.body: Care home delivery: rear service door only and infection-control sign-in. Keep the noise down near the residents' wing and remove all packaging before we leave. In-room placement as per the room list.

notes.author: Transport office
notes.body: Run the demount load over the public weighbridge at Stourton before the trunking leg to confirm axle weights. VEH-007 is off-road so VEH-005 may need to cover - check tacho hours first.

notes.author: Transport manager
notes.body: Two consecutive night shifts on the London office move - keep a close eye on EU 561/2006 daily driving and rest. Foreman is aware; plan the WTD break into the schedule.

notes.author: Carl Drummond (client)
notes.body: End-of-tenancy clearance only - sofa, bed and two white goods. The fridge and washer are WEEE; please send us the waste transfer note for our records. Keys with the branch.

notes.author: Driver DRV-005
notes.body: MOT due 18 Sep - flagging early so it can be booked around the diary. Brakes feel fine; adblue topped up this week. Curtain straps on nearside need replacing soon.

notes.author: Dr Helen Marsden (client)
notes.body: Return leg only once the refurb passes its safety check. Same handling as the outbound - data-logger running end to end, and please replenish dry ice before you set off from your cold store.

advisories: replace nearside front tyre within 4 weeks
